source_refs.note: Example 25.2.3 C₆H₅COCH₃ (acetophenone, TM): a main subheading of 25.2 Retrosynthesis and Synthesis of Some Compounds, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 137-139.

blocks.text: Pehle step mein acetophenone (TM) ka ring aur C=O group ke beech C–C bond toora gaya. Is se aryl anion (C₆H₅⁻) aur acylium (CH₃CO⁺) cation synthons bane.

blocks.alt: Acetophenone (C(=O)CH3 wala benzene), ring aur carbon ke bond par wavy (lehredaar) slash, 'Disconnection' arrow, phir negative charge wala benzene ring synthon (A) aur acylium ion H3C-C(=O)+ synthon (B).
blocks.caption: Example 25.2.3, Step I: acetophenone ka disconnection (kitab ke page 138 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: In synthons ko neutral kar ke synthetic equivalents milte hain: benzene aur acyl chloride.

blocks.alt: Synthon (A) benzene (SE) ke barabar aur synthon (B) acyl chloride H3C-CO-Cl (SE) ke barabar.
blocks.caption: Example 25.2.3, Step II: synthetic equivalents (kitab ke page 138 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: Acetophenone benzene aur acyl chloride ke reaction se banta hai, AlCl₃ catalyst ki presence mein. Is process ko Friedel-Crafts acylation kehte hain.

blocks.title: Interesting Information (dilchasp maloomat)
blocks.text: Cholesterol ki landmark (yaadgaar) synthesis pehli baar early 1950s mein do competing (muqabla karne wale) groups ne ki: aik group ko Oxford mein Robert Robinson aur doosre ko Harvard mein R. B. Woodward lead kar rahe the. Cholesterol ki yeh synthetic schemes pehle hi biological studies se predict (andaza) ki ja chuki thin.

blocks.prompt: a) Aniline ki synthesis mein benzene ki nitration kyun ki jati hai?
blocks.explanation: Amino group seedha benzene par nahi lagaya ja sakta, lekin nitro group electrophilic substitution se aasani se lag jata hai. Phir nitro group ko Sn + HCl se NH₂ mein reduce kar diya jata hai (FGI).

blocks.alt: Phenyl ethanoate: benzene ring (hexagon jis ke andar circle hai) apne oopar daen kone se O se jura hai; yeh O aik C se jura hai jis par oopar daen CH3 hai aur neeche double bond se O hai.
blocks.caption: Phenyl ethanoate, Quick Check 25.2 (kitab ke structure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Yeh aik ester hai: beech wala O ring ko C=O group se jorta hai. Sawal (b) mein isi ester ke C–O bond (ring wale O aur C=O ke darmiyan) par disconnection hota hai: aik hissa ring + O (phenol ki taraf), doosra CH₃–C=O (ethanoyl group).

blocks.prompt: b) Phenyl ethanoate (CH₃COOC₆H₅) medicines (dawaiyan) banane mein kaam aata hai. Is ka retrosynthetic tree, synthetic equivalents aur linear synthesis batayein.
blocks.explanation:
(i) Retrosynthetic tree: ester ka C–O bond torein: CH₃COOC₆H₅ ⇒ CH₃CO⁺ (synthon A) + C₆H₅O⁻ (synthon B).
(ii) Synthetic equivalents: CH₃CO⁺ ke liye ethanoyl chloride (CH₃COCl), aur C₆H₅O⁻ ke liye phenol (C₆H₅OH).
(iii) Linear synthesis: CH₃COCl + C₆H₅OH → CH₃COOC₆H₅ + HCl, NaOH jaise base ke saath (phenol ethanoic acid se achhi tarah ester nahi banata).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai phenyl ethanoate hepatitis aur infections ki dawaiyan banane mein istemal hota hai. Is ka koi standard saboot nahi; dawaiyon mein is ka maloom istemal paracetamol banane mein intermediate (beech ka compound) ke taur par hai. Shayad kitab ne isay sodium phenylacetate (C₆H₅CH₂COONa) se mila diya, jo alag compound hai.

items: Ethyl acetate: ester ka C–O disconnection ⇒ acetic acid + ethanol; synthesis esterification.
Aniline: FGI (NH₂ ⇒ NO₂) ⇒ benzene + nitric acid; nitration phir Sn + HCl se reduction.
Acetophenone: C–C disconnection ⇒ benzene + acyl chloride; Friedel-Crafts acylation (AlCl₃).
